lessons.title: Tide Jumper: a runner where the button moves the sea
lessons.summary: A one-button runner where holding raises the sea instead of jumping, with a playable prototype and the tide mechanic in Lua.

lessons.title: Lighthouse Sweep: one beam, many ships, one button
lessons.summary: A one-button night-sea game where your lighthouse beam decides which ships can see, with a playable prototype and the steering in Lua.

lessons.title: Orbit Hopper: let go at the right moment
lessons.summary: A one-button space climber where you orbit a shrinking planet and press to fly off along the tangent, with a playable prototype and the orbit code in Lua.

lessons.title: Morse Garden: plant flowers with dots and dashes
lessons.summary: A one-button gardening game where short and long presses spell the seed you plant, with a playable prototype and the press reader in Lua.

lessons.title: Drawbridge Duty: one bridge, two queues, one button
lessons.summary: A one-button traffic game where holding raises a bridge for boats and releasing lowers it for carts, with a playable prototype and the bridge rules in Lua.

lessons.title: Kite in a Storm: reel in to climb, let go to escape
lessons.summary: A one-button storm game where holding reels a kite in and releasing lets line out, with a playable prototype and the kite physics in Lua.

lessons.title: Spinning Top Sumo: a duel where you only choose when
lessons.summary: A one-button duel where each top's aim arrow spins on its own and a press dashes that way, with a playable prototype and the dash and collision code in Lua.

lessons.title: Statue Garden: creep while the eyes are shut
lessons.summary: A one-button stealth game where you hold to creep and let go to freeze as a statue, with a playable prototype and the eye timers in Lua.

lessons.title: Hot Iron: hold to heat, let go to strike
lessons.summary: A one-button smithing game where holding heats the metal and letting go strikes it, with a playable prototype and the heat rules in Lua.

lessons.title: One-Switch Lift: run a building with a single lever
lessons.summary: A one-button management game where the lift drives itself and your only control flips its direction, with a playable prototype and the lift logic in Lua.

lessons.title: Magnet Marble: steer a ball you are not allowed to touch
lessons.summary: A physics puzzle where you guide a rolling marble only by flipping magnets between pull and push, with a playable prototype and the force code in Lua.

lessons.title: Sand Sorter: draw the walls, let the sand decide
lessons.summary: A falling sand puzzle where you draw and erase thin walls to route two colours of sand into their jars, with a playable prototype and the sand rule in Lua.

lessons.title: Gravity Postman: aim once, let the planets finish the route
lessons.summary: A slingshot delivery game where you choose only the direction and power of a letter and gravity bends the rest, with a prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Balloon Winds: steer by choosing your altitude
lessons.summary: A balloon game where you cannot steer and only rise or sink into wind layers, with a playable prototype and the balloon physics in Lua.

lessons.title: Rope Bridge in the Wind: build with something that only pulls
lessons.summary: A bridge building game where your only material is rope, which pulls but never pushes, with a playable prototype and the rope physics in Lua.

lessons.title: Spring Creature Workshop: build a body, then teach it to walk
lessons.summary: A sandbox where you build creatures from points, springs and pulsing muscles and race them, with a playable prototype and the muscle physics in Lua.

lessons.title: Water Wheel Workshop: light a village with water you never touch
lessons.summary: A calm physics toy where you arrange gutters so falling water spins a wheel and lights a village, with a playable prototype and the wheel code in Lua.

lessons.title: Paper Plane Wind Tunnel: tune the fold, then let go
lessons.summary: A tinkering game where you tune a paper plane's wing, nose weight and throw to land on targets, with a playable prototype and the flight code in Lua.

lessons.title: Tilt Tray Twins: one tilt, two marbles, two holes
lessons.summary: A physics puzzle where one tilting tray steers a slippery and a grippy marble at once, with a playable prototype and the grip code in Lua.

lessons.title: Bubble Freight: float the crates, mind the thorns
lessons.summary: A physics game where you blow bubbles around crates and fan them over spikes, trading lift for lifetime, with a playable prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Shadow Stencil: paint a wall with the dark you cast
lessons.summary: A calm puzzle game where you move one lamp until the shadows of fixed blocks match a pattern on the wall, with a playable prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Ghost of Your Last Try: a heist crew made of your past runs
lessons.summary: A puzzle platformer where every rewind leaves a ghost that repeats your last run, so you team up with yourself. Playable prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Folding Map: fold the paper, shorten the road
lessons.summary: A calm grid puzzle where folding a paper map folds the land, so far tiles meet and the traveller steps across. Playable prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Pigment Slide: every block moves, every collision mixes
lessons.summary: A sliding puzzle where all the paint moves at once and every collision mixes colours, so you must keep some apart. Playable prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Wire Snake: the route you crawl is the circuit you build
lessons.summary: A grid puzzle where a wire snake crawls from a battery to a lamp on a fixed reel, never crossing itself or water.

lessons.title: Gravity Painter: down is free, every other way costs paint
lessons.summary: A grid puzzle where you paint cells with a direction of gravity on a tight budget, then drop a ball that obeys the paint.

lessons.title: River Numbers: steer a river by nudging the land
lessons.summary: A calm grid puzzle where water takes the lowest way down and you raise or lower a few tiles to bring the river to every field.

lessons.title: Melting Blocks: shrink to fit, grow to press
lessons.summary: A block-pushing puzzle where heaters shrink the ice and freezers grow it back, so you manage its size to fit gaps and press buttons.

lessons.title: Clockwork Locksmith: every turn pushes back
lessons.summary: A gear lock puzzle where turning one gear turns its neighbours the other way, and every mark must point up.

lessons.title: Packing Day: last in, first out
lessons.summary: A moving-van puzzle where boxes fall into place, fragile items need nothing on top, and each room's things must come out first.

lessons.title: Heartbeat Runner: your pulse is the metronome
lessons.summary: A rhythm runner where every step must land on your own heartbeat, and sprinting makes that beat faster. Playable prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Parcel Loop: deliver before the town forgets
lessons.summary: A time loop delivery game where a town resets every minute and only your memory of everyone's schedule carries over. Playable prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Metronome Duel: commit late, strike on the beat
lessons.summary: A rhythm fencing duel where moves land only on the beat, and committing early lets your rival read you. Playable prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Polyrhythm Juggler: two hands, two tempos
lessons.summary: A juggling rhythm game where each ball falls on its own period, so your two hands keep two different beats at once. Playable prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Beat Typist: every letter lands on the beat
lessons.summary: A typing rhythm game where each letter must land on a beat and long words become half-beat drum fills. Playable prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Orchard of Hours: borrow time from one tree to ripen another
lessons.summary: A calm puzzle where three trees share one fixed pool of hours, and you move hours between them until all three bear fruit at once.

lessons.title: Echo Canyon: shout the bridge before you walk it
lessons.summary: A rhythm platformer where each shout returns two seconds later as a brief platform, so you build the path ahead of you on the beat.

lessons.title: Single Track Timetable: four trains, one line, one place to pass
lessons.summary: A planning game where four trains share one track and a passing loop, and you set departure times before watching the day play out.

lessons.title: Sundial Stealth: wind the sun, hide in what it casts
lessons.summary: A stealth game where you turn the sun forward to move the shadows you hide in, and the day only runs one way. Playable prototype and Lua code.

lessons.title: Borrowed Seconds Kitchen: steal time from one pan to save another
lessons.summary: A cooking game where you never touch the food, only move seconds between pan timers, and every second you take must come from another dish.
